{

 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Recover cells whose four lattice vertices all carry one marker color."""
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The large tiled field and its lattice are the two most common colors;
    # all less-common colors are vertex markers.
    common = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_colors = set(counts) - set(common)
    marker_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in marker_colors for v in row)]
    marker_cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0]))
                   if any(grid[r][c] in marker_colors for r in range(len(grid)))]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(marker_rows, marker_rows[1:]):
        row_out = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(marker_cols, marker_cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            if corners[0] in marker_colors and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row_out.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row_out.append(fill)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
"
}
